podcast.title: Left The Cure Before Disintegration Tour Leg
podcast.body: Roger O'Donnell departed from The Cure just before the final leg of their 1991 Disintegration Tour. His departure created an opening that was filled by guitar tech Perry Bamonte, who transitioned to keyboardist for the band. "But when Roger O'Donnell left the cure just before the final leg of the disintegration tour in 1991, Perry Bimonte became the band's keyboardist and after that he played guitar on the next four albums."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

xref.title: Joined The Cure as Keyboardist, then Guitarist
xref.body: In 1991, Perry Bamonte joined The Cure as their keyboardist, stepping in when Roger O'Donnell left just before the final leg of the Disintegration tour. Following this, he also played guitar on the band's next four albums. "But when Roger O'Donnell left the cure just before the final leg of the disintegration tour in 1991, Perry Bimonte became the band's keyboardist and after that he played guitar on the next four albums."
